authorization.instruction_zh: 我们所有归纳的问题，还有改进都汇总了吗？而后继续处理下一步
authorization.scope: Consolidate current human-labelled failures/improvements, then execute the next bounded prose step in Chat.

current_open_defect.human_locator_zh: ‘埋了。’ / ‘哪儿？’ / ‘不知道。’ 这种类型的真的很ai，看起来非常不真实。

pilot_scope.goal: Preserve the newly successful emotional/subjective surface while testing whether dialogue can lose author-serving Q&A regularity without becoming padded or artificially messy.

acceptance_questions: 人物的感情和内心是否仍然自然？
是否还有明显像作者摆好的问一句答一句？
哪一句或哪一小段最先让你觉得AI？
stop_rule: After this bounded pilot, wait for actual-human reading judgment before scaling or turning the working diagnosis into a rule.
